finding.summary: The two-update-trial reservation omitted one charged Escape action and possible write per updated field per trial.
finding.consequence: A near-budget learning run could pass its complete-experiment gate, fill a record, and exhaust its budget before save/readback or during the second trial.

base_one_field_menu_boundaries.max_writes_16: one trial completed; second trial filled before budget exhaustion
base_one_field_menu_boundaries.max_writes_17: one trial completed; second trial filled and dismissed before budget exhaustion
base_one_field_menu_boundaries.max_actions_29: one trial completed; second trial filled and dismissed before budget exhaustion
base_one_field_menu_boundaries.max_actions_30: one trial completed; second trial filled and dismissed before budget exhaustion

runtime_changes: The initial learning gate reserves one worst-case retained Escape for every updated field in each of two trials when the browser exposes the popup-observation and retained-dispatch methods.
The per-route gate repeats the same remaining-trial reserve after the current navigation has been charged.
Browsers without the popup methods retain the prior ordinary-update budget because they cannot discover or dispatch the optional action.
candidate.boundary_result: At max_writes=17 and max_actions=30, learning retains CREATE and READ, reports zero confirmed update trials, and performs zero update fills and zero Escapes.

retained_development_logs.test_meter: Control run imported the unchanged main runtime and reproduced both new boundary failures; 314 other non-slow cases passed.
retained_development_logs.test_meter_v2: First candidate iteration exposed over-reservation for browsers without popup methods; 314 cases passed and two existing ordinary-menu boundaries failed.

remaining_review_result: No second concrete defect was found in the bounded popup paths. Publication follows two saved and reloaded trials, unlearned popup rules are refused, and retained-control plus ARIA restoration checks fail closed.
limitations: The Chromium-marked test and live applications were not run during this review; live timing races were not exercised.
